goal: Demonstrate independently managed Save and Open organs while preserving all six Notepad obligations and user draft state.

target.description: An offline-style plain text notepad with visible controls, text editing, file open/save and draft recovery
target.source: functional description, not a copied implementation
target.fidelity_semantics: depth 1 surface; depth 2 direct events; depth 3 files and persistent consequences

oven.assumption: Consistent execution of sufficiently explicit recipe

acceptance: Every required anchor must carry explicit evidence; no credit for untested capabilities.

anchors.statement: Window, text area, menu, and stage indicator render on initial load
anchors.test: Open browser preview; observe editor and menu and stage indicator

anchors.statement: Typing into the initial editor keeps working and draft survives page reload where browser storage is available
anchors.test: Type sample, reload, verify same text; test behavior when storage is disabled

anchors.statement: Select All, Clear and character counter behave as specified
anchors.test: Bake through depth 2; select text, test Clear cancel/accept and count changes

anchors.statement: User can download exact editor content as UTF-8 plain text through Save
anchors.test: Bake through depth 3; type multiline/Unicode, Save, inspect downloaded .txt bytes

anchors.statement: User can open a local UTF-8 text file without silently discarding the existing draft
anchors.test: Open a sample text file, verify content; cancel replacement while draft is nonempty

anchors.statement: Unimplemented capabilities stay gated, and completion is not declared without all required Anchor evidence
anchors.test: At F1 confirm Save disabled; before acceptance check phase BUILDING; after all accepted complete recipe
